description: This is a PHP unit test class for the JobCategoryDao data access object within the OrangeHRM project. It tests retrieving a list of job categories and fetching a specific job category by ID.

classes.name: JobCategoryDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing JobCategoryDao methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates an instance of JobCategoryDao, sets up test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of job categories and asserts the count.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific job category by ID and checks its name.
